title: aster umbellatus var. humilis
intro: Aster umbellatus var. humilis, commonly known as White Wood Aster or Small White Wood Aster, is a flowering plant native to eastern North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support immune function and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of White Wood Aster include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Aster umbellatus var. humilis include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
